subject: [PATCH v2 11/17] selftests/mm: cover a shared-source collapse write race

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test case to the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c file, which checks for a shared-source collapse write race in the Linux kernel. The test case simulates a scenario where a parent process writes to a shared range while a child process collapses it, and verifies that the content remains isolated during this process. The patch passes on an unmodified kernel, indicating that the isolation provided by khugepaged collapse is sufficient to prevent data corruption. The new test case is designed to ensure that CoW (Copy-on-Write) functionality works correctly in this scenario.
